meta.title: 教学示例：商场湿滑地面，整套过失分析
meta.jurisdiction_context: 香港项目背景；适用法律尚未核验

issues.proposition: 本路径主张被告对该原告及该类风险负有注意义务
issues.basis: 需核验关系、控制或承担责任、风险及适用法；不设置分数阈值
quantifiable_observations: 收到的风险通知次数及时间
issues.cannot_infer_from: 控制比例或接触频率不能直接决定注意义务

issues.proposition: 事故前的行为违反了适用的注意标准
issues.basis: 风险引擎仅提供经济权衡；还需法定要求、情境、行业做法和合理可得知识
quantifiable_observations: 完成巡检次数/应有巡检次数
各措施年化成本、风险减少额
issues.cannot_infer_from: 净经济收益大于零不能自动将本项设为成立

issues.proposition: 依适用因果规则，该违反义务导致了本次损害
issues.basis: 需具体机制与反事实证据；群体相对风险不是个体原因概率
quantifiable_observations: 有措施与无措施群体的事故率及置信区间
issues.cannot_infer_from: 措施降低60%事故率不等于有60%概率造成这位原告的伤害

issues.proposition: 所主张损失处于本案适用的责任范围内，未被相关限制排除
issues.basis: 依案件类型分析义务范围、损害类型、介入原因及过远性
issues.cannot_infer_from: 距离或时间不存在本工具通用的法律截断点

issues.proposition: 存在且已证明适用法承认的可赔损害
issues.basis: 必须审核项目资格、证明、重复计算及估值
quantifiable_observations: 获认可的非财产损害估值
issues.cannot_infer_from: 教学估值不等于法院会判赔的金额

issues.proposition: 本路径未被适用的完全抗辩、时效或其他程序障碍阻却
issues.basis: 按案件启用相应规则；unknown不代表抗辩已经证明；举证责任需另行核验
quantifiable_observations: 法定起算、暂停及延展所需的日期
issues.cannot_infer_from: 仅按事故日加固定年数不能确定时效

issues.proposition: 可赔项目、减损扣额、共分疏忽比例及适用顺序已有依据
issues.basis: 示例20%只作情景输入；不由模型评分生成
quantifiable_observations: 经证明可避免损失金额
issues.cannot_infer_from: 缺少扣减证据不自动意味着应扣0%或100%

cohort_association.note: Descriptive association only; nonrandom assignment, confounding and sampling error remain. It neither estimates individual causation nor automatically sets the preventive effect input.

point_estimate.method: triangular_modes; not the mean of the uncertain output

measures.name: 方案C：防滑设施与驻点人员

bounds.method: conservative input corners; not confidence intervals

measures.name: 方案C：防滑设施与驻点人员

simulation.method: independent triangular parameter draws with a shared baseline

net_benefit_by_measure.name: 方案C：防滑设施与驻点人员

simulation.tie_policy: baseline first, then input order; numerical equality tolerance 1e-12

assumptions: All monetary inputs use one currency and price year; all comparisons are annual.
N is annual exposures and p is event probability per exposure; N*p is an expected event count, not a probability.
Loss-category shares are fixed, mutually exclusive, exhaustive and conditional on one event.
Loss components within each category are additive and must not double-count the same loss.
Each measure is an alternative complete package; effects of separate packages are not combined.
Initial cost is annualized over its useful life with no residual value; annual costs and risks are stationary.
The same loss-proportion reduction applies across categories; probability and severity reductions multiply residual loss.
Monte Carlo assumes independent marginal triangular parameter distributions; all measures share each draw's baseline probability and losses.
Monte Carlo represents input uncertainty, not realized accidents or a probability of legal liability.
positive_share is the fraction of assumed parameter draws with positive net benefit; mc_standard_error is simulation error, not empirical uncertainty.
Equal economic values use relative and absolute floating-point tolerances of 1e-12; baseline wins ties.
Economic support, risk differences and relative reductions do not establish legal breach or causation.

claimant_damages.note: Scenario only. Eligibility, deduction applicability and order need external legal findings.

non_monetized_constraints.effect: 不能因缺少估值而记作零；当前经济排名不覆盖这些维度

input_audit: All demonstration values are synthetic; no empirical calibration has been established.
E1: synthetic; 假设事故前同类区域有100000次通行、8次事故；并非真实统计
E2: synthetic; 假设措施成本报价与有效性范围；尚无对照实验
E3: missing; 租约、控制权、人员职责、适用成文规定与判例
E4: missing; 事故录像、清洁记录、医师及工程专家的因果意见
E5: synthetic; 假设个案发票、收入、护理和非财产损害数值
E6: missing; 可预见性、第三方介入、共分疏忽、减损、时效及适用抗辩证据
No risk score establishes duty, breach, factual causation, remoteness, or a defence.
The selected option minimizes monetized expected cost only among the declared options.
Tail severity, distributional effects and non-monetized rights remain separately recorded.
Relative risk and risk reduction do not equal the probability that this defendant caused this injury.
